handle_follow_deep_override_only.classification_evidence: The week-blocked interval's upper end is +0.78, above zero, so the sign is NOT resolved and wrong_sign_resolved is inadmissible; the foresight control bounds nothing at this scale.
handle_follow_deep_override_only.description: Following the heavy handle only when it overrides a pick the served card holds beyond the frozen median override distance, against the ungated rule as served
handle_follow_deep_override_only.notes: 18 flips. Season-blocked P+ 0.2344. Week 1's ARI at LAC sat at override distance 0.138, near this group's maximum 0.1394.
handle_follow_deep_override_only.plain_summary: When the big money would overturn a pick the card felt sure about, following it has hurt: the card was 11-7 on those and following the money makes it 7-11.

handle_follow_override_foresight_control.classification_evidence: A control, not a closure: it shows the harness resolves a 6.9-point effect at 19 flips and therefore bounds nothing at the 1.5-to-2-point scale the candidate arms live at.
handle_follow_override_foresight_control.description: Perfect-foresight control on the heavy-handle flip set, frozen lane-S population
handle_follow_override_foresight_control.plain_summary: If every heavy-money flip went the right way, the card would gain about seven points - the yardstick showing the test can see a big effect at this number of games.

handle_follow_shallow_override_only.classification_evidence: No resolved wrong sign and no positive control bound; the foresight control on the same 19 flips reads +6.92 [+3.92, +10.15], well above this effect.
handle_follow_shallow_override_only.description: Following the heavy handle only when it overrides a pick the served card holds within the frozen median override distance (0.0261), against the ungated rule as served
handle_follow_shallow_override_only.notes: Second look at the frozen lane-S population; H1 reproduced exactly (73 fires, 37 flips, +0.3846). Season-blocked P+ 0.8112.
handle_follow_shallow_override_only.plain_summary: Following the big money helps when it only overturns a pick we were unsure about; on those the card was 7-12 and following the money makes it 12-7.
